supporting_evidence.summary: significant deviations in scope [all services]: currencyservice_latency-50 z=337.49 (1687.5%); checkoutservice_latency-90 z=130.47 (689.2%); frontend_latency-90 z=104.93 (703.6%); currencyservice_latency-90 z=83.88 (788.2%)
traces for currencyservice: SIGNIFICANT change; own spans self-time p50 0.14->0.1ms (0.71x), errors 0.0->0.0; inbound calls self-time p50 5.18->92.02ms (17.76x), errors 0.0->0.0

alternatives_rejected.why: Its p90 latency deviation (z=130.47) is far smaller than currencyservice's p50 (z=337.49) (E1). Checkout calls currency, and currency's inbound latency rose 17.76x (E2), so checkout's slowdown follows from waiting on currency.
Frontend's p90 rise (z=104.93, E1) is downstream of the checkout and currency slowdown. Inbound currency latency jumped 17.76x (E2), consistent with frontend being a victim.
Currencyservice's own span self-time did not rise (p50 0.14->0.1ms). Only caller-observed latency rose (E2), which fits added network delay, not CPU saturation.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect and remove the added network delay on currencyservice's pods or network path (e.g. tc/netem rules, sidecar or network policy). If it persists, reschedule the currencyservice pods onto healthy nodes, then confirm caller-observed latency returns to about 5ms p50.
